# uptimeify_dns_monitor (Data Source)

Look up one DNS monitor by numeric id or public id. Secrets are never readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_dns_monitor" "this" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric id or public id.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_check_country_codes` (Set of String) Upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the allowed check locations. Unset = all locations.
- `check_interval` (Number) Minutes between checks, 1 to 1440. Defaults to 30. The customer's package can require a larger minimum.
- `created_at` (String)
- `customer_id` (Number) Customer the monitor belongs to. Changing it moves the monitor to another customer of the same organization in place.
- `expected_values` (Map of List of String) Expected answers per record type (upper-case key); every type in `record_types` needs at least one value. Values unique and without surrounding spaces.
- `hostname` (String) Host name or IP address only: no scheme, no path, no spaces.
- `management_type` (String) `managed` or `self_service`. Only organization writers choose it; customer tokens always get `self_service`. Defaults to `managed`.
- `match_mode` (String) `exact` (answer set equals the expected values) or `contains` (answer includes them).
- `name` (String) Display name, 1 to 255 characters.
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `public_id` (String) Public UUID of the DNS monitor.
- `record_types` (List of String) Record types to resolve, upper case and unique, e.g. `["A", "MX"]`.
- `require_expected_values` (Boolean) Defaults to false.
- `status` (String) `active`, `maintenance` or `disabled`. Defaults to `active`.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Timeout per check in seconds, 1 to 60. Defaults to 30.
- `trigger_on_mismatch` (Boolean) Alert when the answers do not match. Defaults to true.
- `trigger_on_resolve_error` (Boolean) Alert when the name does not resolve. Defaults to true.
- `updated_at` (String)
